name: Electricity · ELEC2
license: Open Database License / Database Contents License
order: Original chronological file order; no shuffle
description: Classify electricity price movement in the Australian NSW market.
notes: Publisher-normalized features are used as supplied. This is contemporaneous classification, not future-price forecasting. No ground-truth drift locations are provided.
span: 7 May 1996 – 5 December 1998 (944 days, one row every 30 minutes)

drift_injection.rule: the two input columns most correlated with the label over the whole file (|r| = 0.379 and 0.334)

warmup_reason: 1,000 rows is about 21 days of half-hourly readings, which covers the daily and weekly cycles.

name: Room occupancy · UCI
license: Kaggle mirror: unknown; original UCI: CC BY 4.0
order: Three source files merged by timestamp; no shuffle
description: Detect room occupancy from five environmental sensor measurements.
notes: Candanedo & Feldheim (2016), UCI Occupancy Detection. Source train/test files are merged into one chronological replay, with timestamps and row IDs excluded from features. This is a new prequential protocol, not the original holdout benchmark. No ground-truth drift annotations.
span: 2–18 February 2015 (about 16 days, one row every minute)

drift_injection.rule: the two input columns most correlated with the label over the whole file (|r| = 0.915 and 0.556)

warmup_reason: 1,000 rows is only 17 hours (one afternoon and one night), so a model trained once on it has never seen a morning. 3,000 rows covers two full days. Measured on 13 October 2026: the train-once baseline scores 23.8 % with a 1,000-row warm-up and 97.9 % with 3,000.

name: Network intrusions · CIC-IDS2017 (corrected)
license: Not stated on the download page. The original CIC-IDS2017 (UNB) asks users to cite Sharafaldin et al., ICISSP 2018; cite both papers.
citation: L. Liu, G. Engelen, T. Lynar, D. Essam, W. Joosen. Error Prevalence in NIDS datasets: A Case Study on CIC-IDS-2017 and CSE-CIC-IDS-2018. IEEE CNS 2022, pp. 254-262.
I. Sharafaldin, A. H. Lashkari, A. A. Ghorbani. Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization. ICISSP 2018.
order: All five days (3-7 July 2017) in one stream, ordered by flow end time (start + duration); ties by start time, day, original id
description: Detect network attacks in real traffic flows captured over one working week; each day brings new attack types at recorded times.
notes: Labels follow the authors' corrected release; flows marked 'Attempted' count as BENIGN, as the authors instruct, and the original label is kept in attack_type. Monday has no attacks. Identifiers (IP addresses, source port, flow id, timestamp) are never model inputs. Columns that never vary are excluded. Zero-duration flows have undefined rates, which are left blank and imputed. The attack periods in the schedule are the dataset's own dated changes, not injected ones.
